title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Sensor Placement in Water Distribution Networks: Systematic Literature Review — Supporting Evidence and Reproducibility Materials
description: Supporting research materials for the systematic literature review, “Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Sensor Placement in Water Distribution Networks: A Systematic Literature Review.” This deposit contains review methods and PICOS eligibility criteria; database-specific search strategies; search and Covidence import provenance; PRISMA flow counts; the included-study register; the recovered 37-record full-text exclusion register; the original Covidence data-extraction CSV and an organised Excel extraction register (four individual study records plus one additional consensus record); extraction provenance and limitations; evidence-gap reconciliation; manuscript-derived study synthesis; and descriptive methodological appraisal materials. The complete decision-level export for all 377 title/abstract records was not recovered. Screening and extraction were conducted by one reviewer. The journal-submission manuscript, working drafts, journal supplementary submission files and publisher-formatted full-text articles are excluded. Third-party rights and limitations are documented in the repository.
